tasks.subject: Task 1: Create the notify-review workflow
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `.github/workflows/notify-review.yml` that posts the PR recap to Discord and pings the reviewer role, guarded and soft-skipping when unconfigured.

**Files:**
- Create: `.github/workflows/notify-review.yml`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Triggers on pull_request types [opened, ready_for_review] for bases development, staging, main.
- Job guarded by `if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false`.
- permissions: contents: read only.
- Missing DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL or DISCORD_REVIEWER_ROLE_ID -> ::warning:: + exit 0.
- Role mention in content; allowed_mentions.roles scopes ping; PR body verbatim in embeds[0].description; env label in embeds[0].title.
- PR body via jq --arg; empty -> _(no description provided)_; >4000 chars truncated.
- actionlint clean.

**Verify:** `actionlint .github/workflows/notify-review.yml` -> exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/notify-review.yml"], "verifyCommand": "actionlint .github/workflows/notify-review.yml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["triggers opened+ready_for_review on dev/staging/main", "draft==false guard", "contents:read only", "missing secret soft-skips exit 0", "role mention in content with allowed_mentions.roles", "PR body verbatim in embed description via jq --arg", "env label in embed title", "actionlint clean"], "modelTier": "standard", "agent": "devops"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Document the Discord CI secrets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Record the two new GitHub Actions secrets in README.md; state explicitly they are CI-only (not .env).

**Files:**
- Modify: `README.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- README.md lists DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL and DISCORD_REVIEWER_ROLE_ID with purpose each.
- Notes they are GitHub Actions secrets, not app env vars, and unset -> soft-skip.
- .env.example NOT modified.

**Verify:** `grep -n DISCORD_ README.md` shows both; `grep -c DISCORD_ .env.example` -> 0.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["README.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -n DISCORD_ README.md && test $(grep -c DISCORD_ .env.example) -eq 0", "acceptanceCriteria": ["README lists both DISCORD_ secrets with purpose", "notes CI-only not app env + soft-skip", ".env.example unmodified"], "modelTier": "standard", "agent": "docs-maintainer"}
```
